market_summary: USD pairs and crypto remain under broader session pressure during London hours, with GBPUSD exhibiting a clear rejection from POC/VWAP backed by elevated RVOL and bearish CVD. XAUUSD and BTCUSD consolidate near session lows without fresh breakdown volume, while EURUSD and US100 remain contained within their respective value area bands awaiting NY liquidity.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (3960.79) and POC (3978.28), confirming a bearish value area regime. CVD is BEARISH (-4.32) with negative slope (-0.9), aligning with trend pressure. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price trades below descending VWAP (3969.59) and EMA50 (3964.15). ATR position is mid-channel between EMA20 baseline (3949.97) and lower ATR band (3935.90). Volume is normal with RVOL 1.082 without yellow spike confirmation. Price recently bounced from Session Low (3924.30) but lacks structural breakout momentum, sitting in a consolidation pocket below key S/R at 3968.55. GEX is null.

Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.10786 to VAH 1.10998) and below POC (1.10943), favoring mean reversion. CVD is NEUTRAL (+2,166) with a declining slope (-1,713.4), indicating fading buying interest. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price sits right at EMA50 (1.10898) and slightly above VWAP (1.10867). Price recently swept near Session High (1.11027) with an RVOL spike (2.04) and rejected back downward inside the ATR channel. Given the neutral CVD divergence and compression around VWAP/EMA20/EMA50, follow-through is mixed. GEX is null.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral hovering around VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection at VAH and Session High

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.32611 to VAH 1.32797) and below POC (1.32738). CVD is BEARISH (-4,133) with a steep negative slope (-758.39), showing strong directional agreement. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price closed below both VWAP (1.32673) and EMA50 (1.32700), and the forming bar is breaking down through S/R 1.32661 toward VAL. Last bar printed a yellow RVOL spike (2.158), confirming institutional selling at the mean. ATR envelope is open toward the lower band (1.32570). Confluence supports a short momentum continuation scalp. GEX is null.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish breaking below VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection at POC and breakdown of S/R

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 28086.57 to VAH 28185.57) and above POC (28121.92), testing VAH. CVD is BEARISH (-2.87) but stabilizing with flat slope (+0.06), diverging slightly from the upward push. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price maintains higher-low structure above VWAP (28133.11) and EMA50 (28160.87). ATR channel is expanding with price trading near the upper quadrant. While US100 Dukascopy tick volume rarely triggers yellow spikes (RVOL 1.173), price is currently pressing right beneath VAH (28185.57) and Session High (28265.71) without sufficient clearance to justify entering directly into resistance. GEX is null.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish holding above VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (73295.04) and POC (73518.45) in a bearish trend expansion state. CVD is BEARISH (-0.05). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is cleanly below downward-sloping VWAP (73532.02) and EMA50 (73490.93). The signal candle produced a relief wick but failed directly under Prev Low resistance (73097.30), remaining near the lower ATR band (72873.64). However, RVOL is 1.591 without yellow spike confirmation, and the market is hovering just above the Session Low (72639.70) bounce zone, presenting elevated chop risk before NY open. GEX is null.
